name: Cards
purpose: A family of container components that group related content (and optionally an action) into a bordered surface. Five types covering interactive and static use, with and without imagery.
$family: This file covers the whole Card family; each type is a separate Figma component.

props.name: state
props.$note: Interactive types only (basic, actions). Non-interactive/image-static types are default-only.

props.name: content
props.$note: Content combinations seen on actions/basic cards.

variants.name: actions
variants.use: Card presenting an item with an action affordance (chevron). Content combos: icon/title/description in various pairings. Static surface (background/default).

variants.name: basic
variants.use: Interactive card (default/hover/pressed). Background shifts via tertiary/background tints on interaction.

variants.name: basic-non-interactive
variants.use: Static version of basic — no hover/pressed; background/default.

variants.name: image-with-border
variants.use: Card with an image plus headline (font-3) and optional headline link; bordered. Responsive image scales (3/5/6/7/8/9).

variants.name: image-without-border
variants.use: Image card without a border; responsive image scales.

common.padding: padding/responsive/medium (16) + padding/fixed/medium (16); large 20 on image cards
common.title: text/default @ font-5/medium
